commentary: IronÊoreÊfuturesÊonÊtheÊDalianÊExchangeÊtradedÊsidewaysÊinÊtheÊmorningÊsessionÊtoday.ÊInﬂuencedÊbyÊmarketÊnews,ÊpricesÊsawÊaÊsharpÊdeclineÊinÊtheÊaŌernoon.ÊTheÊmainÊ contractÊI2605ÊulƟmatelyÊclosedÊatÊ757,ÊdownÊ1.3%ÊfromÊtheÊpreviousÊtradingÊday.ÊTradersÊshowedÊlimitedÊwillingnessÊtoÊoﬄoadÊgoods,ÊwhileÊsteelÊmillsÊremainedÊ cauƟousÊinÊtheirÊprocurement.ÊOverallÊmarketÊtradingÊacƟvityÊwasÊsubdued.ÊInÊShandong,ÊtheÊtransacƟonÊpriceÊforÊPBÊﬁnesÊrangedÊfromÊ775ÊtoÊ780ÊyuanÊperÊton,ÊdownÊ5 –8ÊyuanÊfromÊyesterday.ÊInÊHebei,ÊtheÊtransacƟonÊpriceÊforÊPBÊﬁnesÊstoodÊatÊ790–795ÊyuanÊperÊton,ÊupÊ5ÊyuanÊfromÊyesterday.
